text: In nineteen twenty five, a con man sold the Eiffel Tower. For scrap metal. Victor Lustig read that Paris could barely afford to fix it. So he faked government papers, and called scrap dealers to a luxury hotel. He told them the tower was coming down. Keep it secret. One dealer handed over the cash. When he found out, he was too embarrassed to tell the police. So Lustig came back, and tried to sell it again. Would you have bought it?
